claims.claim: The paper introduces a reliability science framework for long-horizon LLM agents with four metrics: Reliability Decay Curve (RDC), Variance Amplification Factor (VAF), Graceful Degradation Score (GDS), and Meltdown Onset Point (MOP).
claims.quote:

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: The evaluation covers 10 models across 23,392 episodes on a 396-task benchmark spanning four duration buckets and three domains.
claims.quote: > evaluate 10 models across 23,392 episodes on a 396-task benchmark spanning four duration buckets and three domains.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: Reliability decay is domain-stratified: SE GDS drops from 0.90 to 0.44 while document processing is nearly flat from 0.74 to 0.71.
claims.quote:
> Key findings: (1) reliability decay is domain-stratified -- SE GDS drops from 0.90 to 0.44 while document processing  
> is nearly flat (0.74 to 0.71);

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: VAF bifurcates by capability tier; high VAF is a capability signature, not an instability signal.
